dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: This peaceful scene puts the mind at ease.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Even the most ordinary stretch of countryside, the humblest of hills, harbors poignant profundities from the distant past.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Offer them your full, undivided attention, and each flower, each tree, each blade of grass will whisper their stories to you.
